watches.name: Hexmariner 39 Sky Blue CNC Guilloche MOP
watches.description: A very unique CNC Guilloche Mother of Pearl dial paired with lume filled carbon fiber bezel insert. Instead of machining a simple rectangular stage for the logo cavity like most Guilloches out there, the complexity arises when we insist in contour machining the stage according to our logo shape which gives the dial a more refined detail. This results in high wastage due to its high precision and narrow tolerance.
